summary.text: Thomas Moakley is a Democratic state representative from Massachusetts who has represented the Barnstable, Dukes, and Nantucket District since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
A former prosecutor, he was born in Falmouth.

paragraphs.text: Moakley was born in Falmouth, Massachusetts.
He earned a bachelor's degree from Georgetown University in 2017 and a law degree from Suffolk University Law School in 2021.
His career experience includes working as a prosecutor, and he has been affiliated with the Eagle Scouts and the Massachusetts LGBTQ Bar Association.
Moakley assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Dylan Fernandes.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the House Committee on Federal Funding, Policy and Accountability and the Joint Committees on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet, and Cybersecurity, on Children, Families and Persons with Disabilities, on Judiciary, and on Tourism, Arts and Cultural Development.
